subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should denied turns retain model-visible schemas for computer, cron, gateway, and nodes when direct and loopback calls are rejected before hooks and side effects?
rationale: The implementation preserves execution denial, but choosing between cache-stable schema visibility and least-capability disclosure is a repository security and product-boundary decision that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Approve stable schemas with hard gates
options.body: Accept the design because immutable direct and loopback checks deny protected calls before hooks and side effects, then review the refreshed merge result.

options.title: Require denied schemas to remain hidden
options.body: Reject the visibility change and redesign prompt-cache stability around filtered protected-tool catalogues.

recommendation.title: Approve stable schemas with hard gates
